FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/rust:1.83.0 AS build
ENV CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 TZ=Asia/Shanghai
RUN mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo && printf '[source.crates-io]\nreplace-with = "rsproxy"\n[source.rsproxy]\nregistry = "sparse+https://rsproxy.cn/index/"\n[net]\ngit-fetch-with-cli = true\n' > /usr/local/cargo/config.toml
WORKDIR /app
COPY app /app
RUN cargo build --release --features sqlite
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates openssl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN useradd -m vw && mkdir -p /data && chown -R vw /data
COPY --from=build /app/target/release/vaultwarden /vw
USER vw
ENV VW_DATA_FOLDER=/data ROCKET_PORT=80 ROCKET_ENV=prod TZ=Asia/Shanghai
VOLUME /data
EXPOSE 80
ENTRYPOINT ["/vw"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/rust:1.83.0 AS build
ENV CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4
RUN apt-get update 2>/dev/null; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends protobuf-compiler 2>/dev/null || true
RUN mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo && printf '[source.crates-io]\nreplace-with = "rsproxy"\n[source.rsproxy]\nregistry = "sparse+https://rsproxy.cn/index/"\n[net]\ngit-fetch-with-cli = true\n' > /usr/local/cargo/config.toml
WORKDIR /app
COPY app /app
RUN cargo build --release
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY --from=build /app/target/release/hbbs /hbbs
COPY --from=build /app/target/release/hbbr /hbbr
COPY entry.sh /entry.sh
RUN chmod +x /entry.sh /hbbs /hbbr
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 21115 21116 21116/udp 21117 21118 21119
ENTRYPOINT ["/entry.sh"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/rust:1.83.0 AS build
ENV CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4
RUN mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo && printf '[source.crates-io]\nreplace-with = "rsproxy"\n[source.rsproxy]\nregistry = "sparse+https://rsproxy.cn/index/"\n[net]\ngit-fetch-with-cli = true\n' > /usr/local/cargo/config.toml
WORKDIR /app
COPY app /app
RUN ls && cargo build --release --bin stalwart-mail || cargo build --release
RUN find target/release -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable | head -20
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY --from=build /app/target/release/stalwart-mail /stalwart-mail
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 443 8080 25 587 465 143 993
ENTRYPOINT ["/stalwart-mail","--config","/opt/stalwart-mail/config.toml"]
